span.p:
Resources and ID stay reserved.
finish returns its cached result.
retryExport replaces the cache,
retains previous errors and can
resume unattempted stages after
producer settlement. Errors remain.
Active producers and failed export
block tracked cleanup even through
parent disposal. Forced context
disposal can consume teardown.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Error does not prove release.
Release requires DISPOSED and
attempted/released outcomes
with nonempty evidence refs.
Cleanup failure can retain the ID.
No terminal cleanup retry or crash
recovery, reservations are local.
